```{r}
library(arules)
library(arulesViz)
library(readr)

# Load & Preprocess
diabetic_data <- read_csv("diabetic_data.csv")
ids_mapping <- read_csv("IDS_mapping.csv")
# Map codes to labels
mapping_list <- split(ids_mapping, ids_mapping$variable)
for (var in names(mapping_list)) {
  map_df <- mapping_list[[var]]
  diabetic_data[[var]] <- as.character(diabetic_data[[var]])
  diabetic_data[[var]] <- setNames(map_df$description, map_df$code)[diabetic_data[[var]]]
}

# Transform & Mine Rules
diabetic_data[] <- lapply(diabetic_data, as.factor)
trans <- as(diabetic_data, "transactions")
rules <- apriori(trans, parameter = list(supp = 0.05, conf = 0.6))
rules_lift <- sort(rules, by = "lift", decreasing = TRUE)

# Visualize
plot(rules_lift, method = "graph", engine = "htmlwidget")

```
